column1: # Pakistan, pk.karachi: Dawat-e-Islami's city cards (rulings R190 and R194, the Pakistan lane of 13 Nov 2026). Dawat-e-Islami (a
# Barelvi movement; Faizan-e-Madina) publishes a card for each city, in seconds, "prepared for the complete boundaries" of the
# city "with other necessary precautions" (its own note): 18 degrees for Fajr and Isha, both Asr columns, and its Maghrib a minute or
# two after the Karachi method's at the same point (the survey's item O9, still the owner's to rule: the cards are held as the
# later of two bodies, not as the proven table of the majority). Each card is a table printed for its own city: a unit of
# SouthAsia.pakistanUnits at the app's own point for that city (Taxila, which the app does not list, at the town's own), with
# its own fitted margins. Every row names its unit (`pk.karachi/<unit>`): a point that resolved to another unit fails the gate.
# The cards are restricted (the private archive only): this file holds paths and the app's own coordinates, never a printed time.
# Split: November 2026, the month held for all 63 cities, is the fit: each city's margins are its November card's own, with a
# safety of 45 s, the same for every card (ruling R235, 13 Nov 2026: a plain request reaches the month the page shows and no
# other, so November 2026 is the only month held so far and no card is held through the seasons yet; the 36 other months once
# held for twelve cities had been asked of the site's month picker, the owner left them to the Lead (his ruling 3 of 13 Nov:
# "you can decide"), and the Lead dropped them under the lanes' web rule, plain GETs only). Each later month can be held by
# one plain GET per city in that month. Nothing is held out, and nothing of Ramadan: the Ramadan 1448 cards of Karachi and
# Lahore once held here have a script-style address on record and no record of how they were asked; they are out until the
# owner rules on them (ruling R237). Fifteen of the November cards (eight Pakistani cities here) are held as the engine
# survey left them on 11 Nov, the request not recorded; the rest are the lane's own recorded plain GETs.
# F is the card's Fajr at the minute at or after its seconds (a start), E the same time at the minute at or before them (the
# end of eating: the card prints one dawn), S its sunrise at the minute at or before, the rest starts.
# Where two bodies differ the later holds every start and the earlier every end: Karachi's unit is held to these rows and to
